source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(col_bounds)-1)] for _ in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for c in range(col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])]
            if sum(v != background for v in cells) == 2:
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
